description: This file is the main controller class for managing extension modules within the OpenCart admin system. It handles listing, installation, and uninstallation of modules, interacts with models and views, and manages permissions and autoloading.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Main controller class for managing extension modules within the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point that outputs the list of modules.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data about available and installed modules for display.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a module extension, including permission setting and autoloader registration.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles removal of a module extension, including permissions and cleanup.
